text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll protect the galaxy with everything 
I've got~... Chaange, Biko~~...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Here it comes... In that case, 
Super Horseshoe Robo Puuuun...ch?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? S-Sorry, is that you, Trainer!? I 
was half-asleep and thought you were a 
monster made gigantic by Japanese 
sweets...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the sentai hero show I watched 
yesterday was so exciting. My heart was 
pounding all night, and I couldn't get to 
sleep...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Biko Pegasus was so overly 
excited that she couldn't get a good 
rest...
